verdict.rationale: Workers offers a globally distributed key-value store (KV) and Queues integration through bindings. Together these cover the caching and job-queue use cases, and community reports confirm KV is easy to use in production. Nothing in the evidence shows these are Redis-compatible, and one community comment calls KV a proprietary, locked-in primitive. Missing for 10: Redis protocol/API compatibility, documented latency characteristics for caching, a single store serving both cache and queue roles.
